xpath.span: Two-factor Authentication ("2FA") is a system of double authentication. The first one is done with your password and the second one with a code you get from a dedicated mobile app. Popular ones includes Aegis Authenticator, 2FAS, Ente Auth and FreeOTP Authenticator.
